No grouping of 3+ un-packaged concepts forms an independent bechina domain.

The teaching's polarity structure is complete and mirrors itself correctly:
  Good counter-force (Package 1: Torah/Jacob) ↔ Evil force (Package 3: Fire/Din)
  Structural container (Package 2: Heart/Joseph) — the neutral intermediary through which the good force acts on the evil force

Conclusion: NO_NEW_PACKAGES.
